messages:
deploybot: Deploy started: env=canary, tag=release-1.22.0, commit=ae3f4b2. Preflight pipeline kicked off (build → test → lint). Notifying channel. :rocket:
ci-bot: BUILD FAILED on job build/linux-x86-64. Linker error in native module 'fastops'. log: /ci/builds/1945/ae3f4b2/build.log
maria: saw the failure. @jon can you grab the build logs? doesn't look like a flake.
jon: pulling logs now. quick grep shows the error: ```
undefined reference to `fast_gemm'
/usr/local/include/eigen3/Eigen...
```
kate: we should gate the canary. Recommend abort rollout and revert tag to release-1.21.8 until hotfix. :warning:
sam: change window is open for another 20m — but safer to abort. can we pin the runtime image to previous and retry? how long to rollback?
jon: rollback is ~5m to flip traffic and re-deploy previous tag. I'll prepare PR to pin the eigen submodule and run a local build.
maria: create rollback ticket and note customer-impact = low. @deploybot please stop rollout.
deploybot: Action taken: rollout aborted at canary stage. Reverted to tag release-1.21.8. Canary traffic restored to stable. Created issue INFR-462 and attached build logs.
ci-bot: Stopping current pipeline for release-1.22.0, rerun disabled until PR hotfix/eigen-pin is merged.
jon: opened hotfix PR #789, pushing pinned submodule commit. kicking off CI build manually, will post link when green. tagging owners @kate @maria for review.
maria: thanks. post the build link when ready. we'll schedule a controlled redeploy after green CI and a short canary window. :thumbsup:
